list.comment:
Refactor UI performance tests to match the Java/Kotlin GPUTestActivity implementation
This commit synchronizes the UI test logic across Flutter and React Native platforms to match the native Android implementation's physics-based animation algorithm.
The following changes were made: - Replaced simple looping animations with a physics-based movement system featuring wall-bouncing logic. - Implemented a dynamic object count system that starts at 250 objects and increments by 250 every second. - Standardized object size to 50px and maximum velocity to ±10 px/frame. - Switched Flutter implementation to use `CustomPaint` and a single `Ticker` for improved performance rendering many objects. - Switched React Native implementation to use `requestAnimationFrame` and `View` transforms instead of the `Animated` library. - Added an on-screen overlay to display real-time metrics including frame samples, object count, and FPS. - Standardized test completion to trigger based on reaching a target sample count from `SampleConfiguration`.

task.summary: Default task
Fix the code complexity

Upgrade Gradle to 8.14
This commit updates the Gradle wrapper distribution URL to version 8.14.

Implement buffered CSV logging, FPS tracking, and configurable sample sizes for the benchmarking suite.
The following changes were made:
- **New Buffered CSV Logging**: Added `BufferedCsvWriter` using `react-native-fs` to efficiently stream benchmark results to disk in chunks, preventing memory overhead during long-running tests. - **Enhanced Metrics**: Introduced `useFpsCounter` hook to track frame rates during test execution and added an `fps` field to `TestResult`. - **Configurable Test Runs**: Added `SampleConfiguration` allowing users to choose between various workloads (from 100 to 1 million samples) via a new UI configuration modal. - **Refactored CPU Test**: Simplified the CPU workload to a mathematical iteration loop that processes in chunks, allowing the JS thread to yield for UI updates and FPS measurement. - **UI Test Updates**: Standardized the UI animation test duration to a fixed 2 seconds. - **Improved Test Runner**: Updated `suite.tsx` to initialize file-based sessions for each run, ensuring all samples are persisted to the device's document directory.

Implement batch mode for benchmark tests and add a new UI Stress Test
The following changes were made: - Added `StressTestActivity` and `StressTestView` to perform high-throughput rendering tests using `Choreographer` and `Canvas` batch drawing. - Refactored `ApiTestActivity`, `CPUTestActivity`, `ImageLoadingActivity`, `LocationTestActivity`, and `RAMTestActivity` to support batch execution using an `iterations` parameter. - Integrated `BufferedCsvWriter` across activities to log individual iteration results to CSV files. - Updated `BenchmarkSuiteActivity` to coordinate batch execution and simplified the progress tracking and live preview logic. - Modified `RAMTest` and `CPUTest` logic to allow configurable iteration counts for more flexible benchmarking. - Updated `SampleConfiguration` display names from Polish to English. - Registered `StressTestActivity` in the Android manifest.

Update activity_benchmark_suite.xml
This commit translates the "Próbki:" label to "Samples:" in the benchmark suite activity layout.

Refactor BufferedCsvWriter to improve thread safety and error handling during asynchronous flushes
This commit updates the `flushAsync` and `close` methods to prevent race conditions and handle potential exceptions when the writer or executor is being shut down.
Key changes: - Added checks for the `closed` state and empty buffers before submitting tasks to the executor. - Wrapped the executor submission in a try-catch block to handle cases where the executor might already be shut down. - Added explicit null checks and state validation inside the async task to prevent writing after the writer is closed. - Improved the `close` method to ensure the writer reference is nulled even if an `IOException` occurs during closure. - Added suppressed exception handling for manual flushes during the shutdown process.

Refactor benchmark suite to improve session management, update test configurations, and replace UI tests with GPU tests.
The following changes were made:
- **Stability & Persistence**: Added state restoration in `BenchmarkSuiteActivity` to prevent crashes and allow session recovery when the activity is recreated. - **Metric Collection**: Modified `SystemMetricsCollector` to support configurable sampling intervals. - **Test Infrastructure**: Removed the redundant initialization of CSV writers in the main suite to prevent file locking and truncation issues, delegating lifecycle management to individual test activities. - **GPU Test Implementation**: Replaced `UITestActivity` and `StressTestActivity` with a new `GPUTestActivity`. This new test features a time-based ramp-up logic (adding 1000 objects per second) for a fixed 100-second duration. - **UI & Configuration**: - Updated `SampleConfiguration` with specific sampling intervals and removed the "Extreme" preset. - Improved UI feedback in `CPUTest`, `RAMTest`, `ApiTest`, and `LocationTest` by adding real-time progress updates. - Added a watchdog timer to `LocationTestActivity` to handle GPS signal timeouts more gracefully. - **Manifest Updates**: Updated `AndroidManifest.xml` to reflect the removal of UI/Stress tests and the addition of the GPU test.

Refactor `BenchmarkSuiteActivity` to simplify data management and fix session restoration issues.
The following changes were made:
- Removed redundant `csvWriters` and `uiDisplayBuffers` from `BenchmarkSuiteActivity`, delegating CSV management to individual test activities to prevent file locking and double-initialization. - Simplified `initializeSession` to focus on directory creation and system metrics initialization. - Removed dead code related to live UI updates and average calculation in the benchmark suite. - Cleaned up `onDestroy` and test transition logic by removing calls to deprecated writer cleanup and checkpoint methods. - Added error logging for CSV write failures in `GPUTestActivity`. - Streamlined `LocationTestActivity` duration calculation.

Update ImageLoadingActivity and SystemMetricsCollector to improve reliability
The following changes were made: - Refactored `ImageLoadingActivity` to use a `Handler` for recursive image loading to prevent potential stack overflow and ensure proper execution on the main thread. - Updated `SystemMetricsCollector` to enforce a minimum sleep interval of 1ms, preventing zero-duration sleep calls. - Cleaned up unused imports and member variables in `ImageLoadingActivity`. - Added nullability annotations and fixed type parameters for Glide's `RequestListener` implementation. - Improved error logging when closing the CSV writer.

update GPUTestActivity to increase initial object count and refactor rendering logic
This commit modifies the GPU stress test to increase the starting load and cleans up the test execution logic.
The following changes were made: - Increased `INITIAL_OBJECT_COUNT` from 100 to 1000. - Extracted object size into a class-level constant `SIZE`. - Removed `targetFrames` and `END_OBJECTS` variables as they were unused or superseded by time-based logic. - Removed the retrieval of "iterations" from the intent. - Simplified `addObjects` to use the new `SIZE` constant. - Cleaned up comments and redundant spacing throughout `GPUTestActivity.java`.

refactor GPUTestActivity to improve code structure and maintainability
This commit refactors the `GPUTestActivity` class by extracting logic into helper methods and introducing constants for better readability.
Key changes: - Introduced constants for `START_OBJECTS`, `TEST_DURATION_MS`, and `OBJECT_SIZE`. - Refactored `onCreate` to use helper methods `initUI`, `initObjects`, and `setupCsv`. - Extracted directory resolution logic into `getBenchmarkDirectory`. - Simplified `doFrame` by delegating tasks to specific methods: `logFrameData`, `manageObjectCount`, `updateUI`, and `updatePositions`. - Improved bounds collision handling by extracting it into `handleBoundsCollision`. - Cleaned up CSV writer management with a dedicated `closeCsvWriter` method. - Improved code formatting and consistency across the file.

refactor GPU test to use fixed sample count instead of time duration
This commit changes the GPU stress test logic to terminate after a target number of samples rather than a fixed time duration.
- Removed "iterations" extra from `BenchmarkSuiteActivity` when launching `GPUTestActivity`. - Replaced `TEST_DURATION_MS` with `TARGET_SAMPLES` (set to 10,000) in `GPUTestActivity`. - Updated the test loop to use `frameCount` against `TARGET_SAMPLES` as the termination condition. - Updated the UI and test results to display sample progress instead of elapsed time.

clean up CPUTestActivity by removing unused constants and comments
This commit simplifies `CPUTestActivity.java` by removing unused private constants and redundant comments within the CPU benchmark execution block.
The following changes were made: - Removed unused `DEFAULT_CPU_ITERATIONS`, `DEFAULT_DURATION_MS`, and `lastUiUpdate` variables. - Removed outdated comments regarding CSV writer initialization and `TestEntry` logic.

Refactor `CPUTestActivity` to improve code structure and readability
This commit refactors the `CPUTestActivity` by extracting the benchmark execution logic into smaller, modular methods. These changes improve maintainability and separate concerns within the activity.
The following changes were made:
- Extracted the main benchmark logic into `runBenchmarkTask`, `performBatchTest`, and `runSingleIteration` methods. - Isolated UI updates and error handling into dedicated helper methods (`updateProgressUI`, `handleSuccess`, and `handleError`). - Improved code readability by cleaning up imports and removing redundant comments. - Streamlined the background execution flow using a more structured method-based approach.

refactor CPU test to use constant sample size and LiveData for UI updates
This commit simplifies the CPU benchmark by replacing dynamic configuration with a constant sample size and leveraging LiveData for more efficient UI progress updates.
The following changes were made: - Removed `getOptimalWriteBufferBytes` and `getCpuIterationsPerThread` from `SampleConfiguration`. - Refactored `CPUTestActivity` to use a fixed `CONSTANT_SAMPLES` value (10,000) instead of intent extras. - Introduced `MutableLiveData` in `CPUTestActivity` to track and observe test progress. - Hardcoded CPU benchmark iterations to 1,000,000 per sample. - Cleaned up unused parameters and methods related to dynamic configuration in `BenchmarkSuiteActivity` and `CPUTestActivity`.

refactor RAMTestActivity to improve code structure and use constant sample count
This commit refactors the `RAMTestActivity` to improve maintainability and readability by modularizing the benchmark logic. It also hardcodes a target sample count, removing the dependency on intent extras for iteration count in several activities.
The following changes were made:
- Extracted benchmark execution into smaller, private helper methods (`performBenchmarkTask`, `runBenchmarkLoop`, `updateUIProgress`). - Hardcoded `TARGET_SAMPLES` to 10,000 in `RAMTestActivity`. - Removed `iterations` extra from intents passed to `RAMTestActivity`, `ImageLoadingActivity`, `ApiTestActivity`, and `LocationTestActivity` in `BenchmarkSuiteActivity`. - Cleaned up imports and used short class names for `TestResult`, `TestEntry`, and `BufferedCsvWriter`. - Added a `TAG` constant and improved logging consistency. - Introduced `calculateRunsPerSample` to handle adaptive load logic.

refactor RAM test to use LiveData for UI progress updates
This commit replaces the manual `runOnUiThread` progress updates in `RAMTestActivity` with `MutableLiveData` to handle UI state more efficiently and consistently.
The following changes were made: - Added `progressLiveData` to `RAMTestActivity`. - Added an observer in `onCreate` to update `statusText` when progress changes. - Refactored `runBenchmark` to post progress updates to `progressLiveData`. - Removed the manual `updateUIProgress` method.

refactor RAMTestActivity to use string resources and simplify method signatures
This commit refactors `RAMTestActivity` to use Android string resources for UI messages and streamlines the benchmark logic.
The following changes were made: - Added `ram_test_progress`, `initializing_ram_batch`, and `error_message` to `strings.xml`. - Updated `RAMTestActivity` to use `getString()` for status updates instead of hardcoded strings. - Simplified `calculateRunsPerSample` to return a constant value and removed the `targetSamples` parameter from several internal methods, opting to use the `TARGET_SAMPLES` constant directly. - Refined error handling in `performBenchmarkTask` to catch specific `IOException`. - Removed redundant comments.

refactor ImageLoadingActivity to use constant sample size and improve code structure
This commit refactors `ImageLoadingActivity` to use a fixed sample size of 10,000 instead of an intent-provided value and reorganizes the logic into smaller, more maintainable methods.
The following changes were made: - Introduced `CONSTANT_SAMPLES` set to 10,000 for image loading tests. - Extracted UI initialization and intent parsing into `initUI` and `parseIntentData`. - Refactored image loading logic into dedicated methods: `performImageLoad`, `createRequestListener`, and `handleLoadResult`. - Improved resource management by centralizing CSV writer initialization and closure logic. - Simplified imports and utilized `TAG` for consistent logging. - Enhanced code readability by breaking down the monolithic `recordResult` and `finishBatch` methods into smaller functional units.

refactor ImageLoadingActivity to use string resources for UI messages
This commit replaces hardcoded strings in `ImageLoadingActivity` with values from `strings.xml` to follow Android best practices.
The following changes were made: - Added `initializing_image_batch` and `image_test_progress` to `strings.xml`. - Updated `initUI` to use `R.string.initializing_image_batch`. - Updated `updateProgressUI` to use formatted string `R.string.image_test_progress`.

refactor image loading progress updates to use LiveData
This commit replaces manual UI thread updates with `MutableLiveData` to handle progress reporting during image loading benchmarks.
The following changes were made: - Introduced `progressLiveData` to track the number of loaded images. - Added an observer in `initUI` to update the `loadingStatus` text whenever the progress changes. - Replaced the throttled `updateProgressUI` method with direct calls to `progressLiveData.postValue`. - Removed the `runOnUiThread` logic in favor of the lifecycle-aware `LiveData` observer.

refactor location benchmark to include system metrics collection and improved UI
This commit integrates the `SystemMetricsCollector` into the location test, allowing for real-time monitoring of CPU and RAM usage during benchmarking. The UI has been updated to display these metrics and a progress bar.
The following changes were made: - Updated `SystemMetricsCollector` to expose current CPU, RAM, and FPS values via getter methods and removed redundant comments. - Refactored `LocationTestActivity` to utilize `SystemMetricsCollector` for background resource monitoring. - Added a watchdog timer to `LocationTestActivity` to handle GPS signal loss and timeouts gracefully. - Enhanced `LocationTestActivity` UI logic to update progress and metrics every 50 samples. - Updated `activity_location_test.xml` with a `ProgressBar` and a `TextView` for displaying real-time system metrics. - Optimized CSV logging in the location test with larger buffer capacities for high-frequency sampling. - Improved cleanup and resource management in `LocationTestActivity` lifecycle methods.

refactor benchmark suite configuration and reduce GPU stress test intensity
This commit simplifies the benchmark suite by removing the user-selectable sample configuration and fixing it to a large sample size. It also adjusts the GPU stress test parameters to be less aggressive.
The following changes were made:
- Removed `sampleConfigSpinner` and associated logic from `BenchmarkSuiteActivity`. - Fixed the default test configuration to `SampleConfiguration.LARGE` (10,000 samples). - Updated `activity_benchmark_suite.xml` to remove the configuration selector UI elements. - Reduced `INITIAL_OBJECT_COUNT` from 1000 to 250 in `GPUTestActivity`. - Reduced the GPU object increment rate from 1000 to 250 per second. - Cleaned up unused imports and constants in `BenchmarkSuiteActivity`.

refactor: simplify CSV writer and standardize test sample counts
- Constantize `TARGET_SAMPLES` to 10,000 in `LocationTestActivity` and `ApiTestActivity`, removing dynamic iteration counts from intents. - Refactor `BufferedCsvWriter` to remove extensive Javadoc comments and simplify internal logic for better maintainability. - Streamline error handling and resource management in `BufferedCsvWriter`, including more concise check-pointing and closing procedures. - Remove redundant permission annotations and unused variables in test activities. - Update UI progress reporting to reflect the new fixed sample target.

Remove system metrics collection and update benchmark behavior
This commit removes the `SystemMetricsCollector` from `BenchmarkSuiteActivity` and `LocationTestActivity` to simplify data collection.
Key changes: - Removed `SystemMetricsCollector` initialization, starting, and stopping logic across multiple activities. - Updated `LocationTestActivity` to manually track and report sample duration and elapsed time in the CSV output. - Disabled system metrics display in the `LocationTestActivity` UI. - Modified `ImageLoadingActivity` to disable Glide's memory and disk caching (`skipMemoryCache(true)`, `DiskCacheStrategy.NONE`) to ensure image loading benchmarks are consistent. - Minor formatting adjustment in `RAMTestActivity`.

refactor: delegate test execution and logging to individual activities
This commit refactors the benchmark suite to delegate the responsibility of running tests and logging detailed results to the individual test `Activity` classes. The `BenchmarkSuiteActivity` now acts as a coordinator, launching each test activity in sequence and collecting only the final summary `TestResult`.
Key changes include: - Each test `Activity` (CPU, RAM, UI, etc.) now manages its own testing loop based on a `sample_count` passed via an `Intent`. - `BufferedCsvWriter` is now instantiated and managed within each test `Activity` to log per-iteration data directly to a dedicated CSV file. - The `BenchmarkSuiteActivity` no longer manages per-iteration logic or individual `csvWriters`. - The UI stress test (`UITestActivity`) has been completely rewritten to use `Choreographer` for a more accurate, load-scaling rendering benchmark. - Build configurations have been updated to include release signing, ProGuard rules for dependencies, and a debug application suffix.

refactor benchmark configuration to use a centralized constant
This commit replaces the `SampleConfiguration` enum and various local `TARGET_SAMPLES` or `CONSTANT_SAMPLES` constants with a single centralized `Config.samplesAmount` value. This ensures consistency across all benchmark activities.
The following changes were made: - Deleted `SampleConfiguration.java`. - Created `Config.java` in a new `consts` package to hold global configuration values. - Updated `BenchmarkSuiteActivity`, `CPUTestActivity`, `GPUTestActivity`, `ImageLoadingActivity`, `LocationTestActivity`, `RAMTestActivity`, and `ApiTestActivity` to use `Config.samplesAmount`. - Updated `.gitignore` to exclude IDE and build-related directories.

Add Glide, Retrofit, Gson, and OkHttp to version catalog
This commit adds several common networking and image loading libraries to the `libs.versions.toml` file to make them available for the project:
- Added Glide for image loading. - Added Retrofit and Gson converter for API communication. - Added OkHttp logging interceptor for network debugging. - Added standalone Gson library.

Refactor ImageLoadingActivity and update ProGuard configuration
This commit refactors the `ImageLoadingActivity` to improve image rendering benchmarks and updates ProGuard rules for better class preservation and Gson support.
The following changes were made: - Refactored `ImageLoadingActivity` to display images in an `ImageView` during the benchmark instead of preloading them in the background. - Added a 16ms delay between image loads to allow for UI thread refresh and accurate rendering benchmarks. - Updated `ImageLoadingActivity` UI with a centered layout and status text updates. - Added `GPUTestActivity` to the Android Manifest. - Switched the application class and activity references in `AndroidManifest.xml` to use the Java package naming convention. - Expanded ProGuard rules to keep all classes in benchmark packages and added specific rules for Gson serialization and model fields. - Improved error handling and logging during the image loading benchmark.

Update dependencies and add support for Kotlin and Ktor
This commit updates the `libs.versions.toml` file to include several new libraries and plugins, while also updating existing dependency versions. Additionally, the `executeBenchmark` method in `BaseTestActivity` was modified to throw an exception.
The following changes were made: - Added Kotlin, Ktor, Coil, and Coroutines dependencies. - Updated versions for `appcompat`, `activity`, `coreKtx`, `retrofit`, and `gson`. - Reorganized and renamed several library entries in `libs.versions.toml` for consistency (e.g., prepending `androidx-`). - Added `kotlin-android` and `kotlin-serialization` plugins. - Updated `BaseTestActivity.executeBenchmark()` to allow throwing exceptions.
Delete activity_main.xml
Add Gradle wrapper executable binary

Add Android debug keystore
This commit adds the `debug.keystore` file to the `android/app` directory, which is required for signing the Android application during the debug build process.
Delete activity_main.xml

Refactor benchmark suite UI and update project configuration
This commit refactors the React Native benchmark suite to simplify configuration and improves the UI. It also adds IDE project files for several Android library modules and updates the workspace configuration.
The following changes were made:
- Hardcoded the benchmark configuration to "medium" (configId 0) and removed the sample size selection modal from `suite.tsx`. - Updated the `BenchmarkSuite` UI to display a fixed "Benchmark Suite" header instead of dynamic status strings when ready. - Increased the results scrollback buffer from 10 to 50 items and simplified the results list display. - Added an "Export Results" button to the suite UI to allow users to view the saved CSV path. - Updated the progress bar color to `#443FD8` and standardized button styles. - Generated and added Eclipse `.project` files for multiple `node_modules` Android sub-projects (including Expo and React Native libraries) to support better IDE integration. - Updated `.idea/workspace.xml` with recent task history, project state, and layout configurations.

Update entry point to delegate to Suite screen
The `index.tsx` entry point now redirects to the `Suite` component instead of `Benchmark` to unify the implementation with other platforms.

Update test screen UI across React and Flutter apps
This commit standardizes the loading and processing screens for various benchmarks in both the React Native and Flutter implementations.
Key changes include: - Simplified the UI for RAM, CPU, and API tests by removing progress indicators and complex layouts in favor of centered text. - Standardized text labels to "CPU processing ...", "RAM processing ...", and "Waiting for location...". - Applied consistent font sizes (18px) and styles across test screens. - Removed the AppBar from the Flutter `image_loading_test.dart` for a cleaner full-screen appearance. - Updated project metadata in `.idea/workspace.xml`.

Update styles in suite.tsx
This commit updates the styling for the `suite.tsx` component to ensure consistent background and text colors.
The following changes were made: - Added a white background color to the root container. - Explicitly set the text color to black for the title and monospace text elements. - Updated the progress bar background color to use a consistent hex code.

Refactor benchmark configuration to use fixed sample settings
This change replaces the dynamic sample configuration options with a fixed set of requirements (10,000 samples).
The following changes were made: - Removed the `SampleConfig` enum and multiple configuration tiers (Small to Extreme) in both Flutter and React implementations. - Standardized `sampleCount` to 10,000, `bufferSize` to 1,000, and `cpuIterations` to 2,000,000 across the benchmark suite. - Updated `benchmark_suite.dart` to reference static `SampleConfig` values instead of an instance-based selection. - Refactored `SampleConfiguration.ts` to export a single `CONFIG` object while maintaining a legacy compatibility function.

Update benchmark suite metrics and UI test object counts
This commit updates the benchmark data collection logic and standardizes initial object counts across Flutter and React implementations.
The following changes were made: - Added `cumulativeTimeMs` tracking to the benchmark suite to measure total elapsed time. - Updated `BufferedCsvWriter` to include `cumulativeTimeMs` in CSV output while removing the `fps` field. - Adjusted the default `rectangleCount` (Flutter) and `SQUARE_COUNT` (React) to 250 to match the Java implementation's initial object count. - Updated project workspace metadata and task history in `.idea/workspace.xml`.

Implement automated benchmark analysis and cross-platform statistical reporting.
This commit introduces a unified reporting system across Kotlin, Java, Flutter, and React Native platforms to generate aggregated performance metrics and visualizations.
The following changes were made:
- Added `analyze_benchmarks.py` script to process CSV data, generate statistical comparisons, and produce PDF charts and Markdown reports. - Added `StatisticsUtils` and `SummaryWriter` utilities to all four platforms to compute metrics (mean, median, std dev, and percentiles P25-P99) during test execution. - Updated `BufferedCsvWriter` in all platforms to include `platform` and `test_name` columns in the raw output for better data traceability. - Modified benchmark suite controllers in each framework to trigger summary generation automatically upon test completion. - Standardized CSV headers and formats across all implementations to ensure compatibility with the new analysis tooling.

The following changes were made: - Deleted `SampleConfiguration.java`. - Created `Config.java` in a new `consts` package to hold global configuration values. - Updated `BenchmarkSuiteActivity`, `CPUTestActivity`, `GPUTestActivity`, `ImageLoadingActivity`, `LocationTestActivity`, `RAMTestActivity`, and `ApiTestActivity` to use `Config.samplesAmount`. - Updated `.gitignore` to exclude IDE and build-related directories.

Add Glide, Retrofit, Gson, and OkHttp to version catalog
This commit adds several common networking and image loading libraries to the `libs.versions.toml` file to make them available for the project:
- Added Glide for image loading. - Added Retrofit and Gson converter for API communication. - Added OkHttp logging interceptor for network debugging. - Added standalone Gson library.

Refactor ImageLoadingActivity and update ProGuard configuration
This commit refactors the `ImageLoadingActivity` to improve image rendering benchmarks and updates ProGuard rules for better class preservation and Gson support.
The following changes were made: - Refactored `ImageLoadingActivity` to display images in an `ImageView` during the benchmark instead of preloading them in the background. - Added a 16ms delay between image loads to allow for UI thread refresh and accurate rendering benchmarks. - Updated `ImageLoadingActivity` UI with a centered layout and status text updates. - Added `GPUTestActivity` to the Android Manifest. - Switched the application class and activity references in `AndroidManifest.xml` to use the Java package naming convention. - Expanded ProGuard rules to keep all classes in benchmark packages and added specific rules for Gson serialization and model fields. - Improved error handling and logging during the image loading benchmark.

Update dependencies and add support for Kotlin and Ktor
This commit updates the `libs.versions.toml` file to include several new libraries and plugins, while also updating existing dependency versions. Additionally, the `executeBenchmark` method in `BaseTestActivity` was modified to throw an exception.
The following changes were made: - Added Kotlin, Ktor, Coil, and Coroutines dependencies. - Updated versions for `appcompat`, `activity`, `coreKtx`, `retrofit`, and `gson`. - Reorganized and renamed several library entries in `libs.versions.toml` for consistency (e.g., prepending `androidx-`). - Added `kotlin-android` and `kotlin-serialization` plugins. - Updated `BaseTestActivity.executeBenchmark()` to allow throwing exceptions.
Add Gradle wrapper executable binary

Add Android debug keystore
This commit adds the `debug.keystore` file to the `android/app` directory, which is required for signing the Android application during the debug build process.
Delete activity_main.xml

Refactor benchmark suite UI and update project configuration
This commit refactors the React Native benchmark suite to simplify configuration and improves the UI. It also adds IDE project files for several Android library modules and updates the workspace configuration.
The following changes were made:
- Hardcoded the benchmark configuration to "medium" (configId 0) and removed the sample size selection modal from `suite.tsx`. - Updated the `BenchmarkSuite` UI to display a fixed "Benchmark Suite" header instead of dynamic status strings when ready. - Increased the results scrollback buffer from 10 to 50 items and simplified the results list display. - Added an "Export Results" button to the suite UI to allow users to view the saved CSV path. - Updated the progress bar color to `#443FD8` and standardized button styles. - Generated and added Eclipse `.project` files for multiple `node_modules` Android sub-projects (including Expo and React Native libraries) to support better IDE integration. - Updated `.idea/workspace.xml` with recent task history, project state, and layout configurations.

Update entry point to delegate to Suite screen
The `index.tsx` entry point now redirects to the `Suite` component instead of `Benchmark` to unify the implementation with other platforms.

Update test screen UI across React and Flutter apps
This commit standardizes the loading and processing screens for various benchmarks in both the React Native and Flutter implementations.
Key changes include: - Simplified the UI for RAM, CPU, and API tests by removing progress indicators and complex layouts in favor of centered text. - Standardized text labels to "CPU processing ...", "RAM processing ...", and "Waiting for location...". - Applied consistent font sizes (18px) and styles across test screens. - Removed the AppBar from the Flutter `image_loading_test.dart` for a cleaner full-screen appearance. - Updated project metadata in `.idea/workspace.xml`.

Update styles in suite.tsx
This commit updates the styling for the `suite.tsx` component to ensure consistent background and text colors.
The following changes were made: - Added a white background color to the root container. - Explicitly set the text color to black for the title and monospace text elements. - Updated the progress bar background color to use a consistent hex code.

Refactor benchmark configuration to use fixed sample settings
This change replaces the dynamic sample configuration options with a fixed set of requirements (10,000 samples).
The following changes were made: - Removed the `SampleConfig` enum and multiple configuration tiers (Small to Extreme) in both Flutter and React implementations. - Standardized `sampleCount` to 10,000, `bufferSize` to 1,000, and `cpuIterations` to 2,000,000 across the benchmark suite. - Updated `benchmark_suite.dart` to reference static `SampleConfig` values instead of an instance-based selection. - Refactored `SampleConfiguration.ts` to export a single `CONFIG` object while maintaining a legacy compatibility function.

Update benchmark suite metrics and UI test object counts
This commit updates the benchmark data collection logic and standardizes initial object counts across Flutter and React implementations.
The following changes were made: - Added `cumulativeTimeMs` tracking to the benchmark suite to measure total elapsed time. - Updated `BufferedCsvWriter` to include `cumulativeTimeMs` in CSV output while removing the `fps` field. - Adjusted the default `rectangleCount` (Flutter) and `SQUARE_COUNT` (React) to 250 to match the Java implementation's initial object count. - Updated project workspace metadata and task history in `.idea/workspace.xml`.

Implement automated benchmark analysis and cross-platform statistical reporting.
This commit introduces a unified reporting system across Kotlin, Java, Flutter, and React Native platforms to generate aggregated performance metrics and visualizations.
The following changes were made:
- Added `analyze_benchmarks.py` script to process CSV data, generate statistical comparisons, and produce PDF charts and Markdown reports. - Added `StatisticsUtils` and `SummaryWriter` utilities to all four platforms to compute metrics (mean, median, std dev, and percentiles P25-P99) during test execution. - Updated `BufferedCsvWriter` in all platforms to include `platform` and `test_name` columns in the raw output for better data traceability. - Modified benchmark suite controllers in each framework to trigger summary generation automatically upon test completion. - Standardized CSV headers and formats across all implementations to ensure compatibility with the new analysis tooling.

Refactor UI performance tests to match the Java/Kotlin GPUTestActivity implementation
This commit synchronizes the UI test logic across Flutter and React Native platforms to match the native Android implementation's physics-based animation algorithm.
The following changes were made: - Replaced simple looping animations with a physics-based movement system featuring wall-bouncing logic. - Implemented a dynamic object count system that starts at 250 objects and increments by 250 every second. - Standardized object size to 50px and maximum velocity to ±10 px/frame. - Switched Flutter implementation to use `CustomPaint` and a single `Ticker` for improved performance rendering many objects. - Switched React Native implementation to use `requestAnimationFrame` and `View` transforms instead of the `Animated` library. - Added an on-screen overlay to display real-time metrics including frame samples, object count, and FPS. - Standardized test completion to trigger based on reaching a target sample count from `SampleConfiguration`.
